title: Flavor Flav, Hillary Clinton weigh in as WNBA takes flak for weekday lunchtime finals game
summary_full: The Atlanta Dream criticized the WNBA for scheduling a Finals game on Thursday afternoon, drawing reactions from Flavor Flav and Hillary Clinton.
